label: prf:noble-gas-characterization
title: Proof of noble gas characterization
html:
Proof. Proof of noble gas characterization

Proof sketch.

The forward direction (closed partition implies inertness) follows from the Hopf stability proposition. A closed sub-Hopf link remains stable under small perturbations of the linking matrix. No single crossing change can open or close a linking site.

The reverse direction (inertness implies closed partition) follows from the shell conjecture. If the electron cloud is not a union of closed sub-links, then at least one trefoil contains an available linking site. The atom lowers its energy by capturing an additional electron, contradicting chemical inertness.
